scope.description: An austere still-life direction for user-specified objects. Arrange a small number of forms with measured intervals on a quiet ground, then use one focused lateral light to distinguish volume and material against a restrained background. Preserve the requested object identities and count; do not import the source painting's fruit, vessels, rose, or religious interpretation.
limitations: Work only with objects and setting supplied or approved by the user; do not add signature fruit, vessels, flowers, or devotional symbols by default.
Keep the arrangement spare without changing object identity, count, or requested placement.
Use a single readable light direction; retain enough shadow detail to keep forms and materials legible.

rules.applies_when: The requested scene is a still life or a deliberately object-led composition.
rules.instruction: Arrange only the requested objects on a simple, readable ground plane; preserve their count and defining placement, and use clear intervals or restrained overlap to keep each form individually legible.
rules.observable: Object silhouettes can be distinguished at a glance and the negative space between them feels intentional.
rules.reject_when: Extra signature props appear, objects merge accidentally, or the arrangement imitates a known painting.
rules.avoid: default citrus, rose, metal plates, devotional objects, and copied source layout

rules.applies_when: The user requests a quiet, materially descriptive still life.
rules.instruction: Establish one focused lateral light direction, describe volume with clear but not crushed shadow shapes, and retain enough detail in darker passages to identify the requested forms.
rules.observable: Light reveals object volume and leaves readable shadow structure without flattening the scene into a global dark filter.
rules.reject_when: Multiple conflicting light sources appear, shadow loses all material detail, or dramatic spotlighting changes the requested mood.
rules.avoid: pitch-black shadow masses, theatrical beams, and uniform vignette

rules.applies_when: The scene contains two or more visually distinct requested materials.
rules.instruction: Differentiate each requested material through its highlight shape, edge character, and small-scale surface cues while keeping the overall brushwork restrained.
rules.observable: Ceramic, fabric, wood, metal, or fruit remain distinguishable without adding ornamental detail.
rules.reject_when: Every object receives the same gloss, texture, or edge treatment, or detail density overwhelms the simple arrangement.
rules.avoid: metallic shine on every surface, decorative excess, and photographic microtexture
